subject: Request: multi-entity invoicing + per-cost-center remittance
messages:
From: Jamie Liao <jamie.liao@novamed.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: accounts-payable@novamed.com
Date: 2026-05-22T08:13:00-07:00
Subject: Multi-entity billing requirements (Novamed / Redwood)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team liked the low-latency routing. Our AP team is trying to lock down how Redwood invoices will be processed across our four legal entities. To avoid rework at month-end we need the following: 

- A single consolidated invoice file per month that is split into per-entity sections (Legal Entity A / B / C / D) with totals and VAT numbers for each entity.
- Line-level cost center allocation (we map each product seat/service line to our internal cost centers). We prefer a machine-readable CSV attachment alongside the PDF invoice.
- Remittance instructions allowing payments to be routed to different bank accounts depending on the entity code.
- Clear VAT registration numbers on each entity subtotal and a per-entity VAT summary.

Attached is a short AP requirements PDF that shows an example layout (Novamed_AP_request.pdf). Can Redwood support this without issuing four separate invoices? If so, what data fields do you need from us and what would the monthly delivery look like?

Regards,

Jamie Liao
Senior Director, Finance Operations
Novamed Health

---
Attachment: Novamed_AP_request.pdf (pdf, 142 KB)
From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Jamie Liao <jamie.liao@novamed.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-22T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Multi-entity billing requirements (Novamed / Redwood)

Hi Jamie — thanks for the clear brief and the sample layout. We can absolutely produce a consolidated billing package that contains per-entity splits and a CSV with line-level allocations; that is our preferred pattern for customers with multiple legal entities. High-level notes: 

1) Data we need from Novamed: 
   - Entity codes and associated bank account (CSV or Doc)
   - VAT registration numbers for each legal entity
   - Mapping rules from Redwood product SKUs to your internal cost center codes (simple CSV mapping is fine)

2) Invoice delivery model we propose: 
   - One PDF "Consolidated Statement" that contains a cover summary and four clearly labeled per-entity sections. Each section shows subtotal, VAT, and the legal entity VAT registration.
   - Companion CSV (entity_allocation_template.csv) with one row per invoice line: invoice_id, invoice_date, sku, description, quantity, unit_price, line_total, entity_code, cost_center_code, vat_amount.
   - We will include per-entity remittance tokens in the invoice footer; those tokens map to bank account instructions in our payment portal (and we can include explicit bank details in the PDF if required for ACH/wire).

3) Edge cases: partial refunds, credits, or chargebacks will be assigned to the original entity_code by default; if you need reallocation rules we can add a reconciliation column to the CSV.

Next steps I propose: I can draft a short SOW and a sample CSV template for you to review. Looping in Kimberly (Accounting) and Ben (Billing Ops) to confirm Redwood's templating fields.

Best,

Soojin Lee
Senior Manager, Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

---
Referenced attachment: entity_allocation_template.csv (stub)
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Jamie Liao <jamie.liao@novamed.com>
Date: 2026-05-23T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Multi-entity billing requirements (Novamed / Redwood)

Quick follow-up from Billing Ops. A few implementation specifics we should confirm before the SOW: 

- We will add a top-level invoice metadata block with fields: legal_entity_code, legal_entity_name, vat_id, remittance_token, bank_account_id. Those will be rendered on the per-entity section and exported row-by-row in the CSV.
- For the remittance_token -> bank mapping: recommend Novamed provide a per-entity bank_id and whether the preferred payment type is ACH / Wire. We will include both human-readable bank details and a token for automated reconciliation.
- For VAT: we can include both VAT-exclusive and VAT-inclusive line_total columns; include 'vat_breakdown' as a structured CSV column (e.g., VAT_5=xx; VAT_10=yy) or keep one VAT amount per line depending on your preference.
- Performance note: producing the consolidated PDF + CSV is a batch job on the 1st and 15th of month by default; if Novamed prefers per-invoice streaming we can do that but it increases costs.

I attached a quick sample CSV we used for a similar multi-entity customer — please review and tell us what columns you need added.

Ben Carter
Director, Billing Operations
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: entity_allocation_template.csv (csv, 3 KB)
From: Jamie Liao <jamie.liao@novamed.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: accounts-payable@novamed.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-25T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Multi-entity billing requirements (Novamed / Redwood)

Soojin / Ben — this looks good and aligns with our requirements. Two quick clarifications before we sign off: 

1) Can Redwood include the VAT breakdown at both the line level and an entity-level summary table? That's useful for our external auditors.
2) For remittance tokens: will Redwood's payment portal return an AP-readable remittance id (so our ERP can auto-apply payments)? We prefer the remittance token to surface back in the CSV as payment_reconciliation_id after posting.

If both are possible, please share the SOW and a sample consolidated PDF layout and CSV within 48 hours and we'll route to Legal / Treasury.

Thanks — Jamie
Senior Director, Finance Operations
Novamed Health
